title: PackageRuntimeMutation
description: Per-sequence digest and disposition needed to compare retransmitted or overlapping runtime prefixes.

launch_session_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

commit_id.description: Durable accepted transaction for this sequence.
commit_id.x-reference-scope: Commit and mutation have the same launch session and occurrence attempt.

sequence.description: Exact contiguous sequence within this launch session.

value_digest.description: Digest of canonical lexical value and exact element address. Use keyed digest for protected small vocabularies.

x-invariants: Only accepted sequences receive a row. A reused sequence is accepted as a replay only if its exact element and value digest match. No raw learner response appears in replay metadata.
